notes.title: Update 1.0.9
notes.content:
Happy launchiversary! The mad scientist behind Proxy truly has gone mad this time.

The problem with updating late-game content is the potential for spoilers, so there's some items that I can't share. You can't see them, but they're there!

Let's get to the notes!

[list]
    [*]Fixed a small bug in [REDACTED] 
    [*]Older saves with "Change Data" jobs will transfer over properly
    [*]Fixed two problems with [REDACTED] (a different [REDACTED] though)
    [*]Threw in an extra piece of content, because why not?
    [*]Learned of a new optimization, HAD to implement it, despite the game not even needing it. I think I might have a problem.
    [*]Oh right, text in the game will not be raycasted against
[/list] 

You know, when you think about it, optimizing something pointlessly is still saving processing cycles, which in turn ends up saving electricity, right? 

And by saving electricity, you don't use any of our planet's precious resources, thus saving the environment. You're a hero, basically.

notes.title: Update 1.0.7
notes.content:
Rejoice! New things! Let's get right to it, shall we?
[list]
    [*]Eliminated the options popup dialog when you hit play
    [*]Replaced with in-game options! (Check out the new menu by selecting the gear!)
    [*]Do you not care for how Americans spell certain words? Prefer color to Color? Well start caring because there's a new language button on the title screen for UK* English!
    [*]This opens up the door for all sorts of language translations. Post your requests in the forums!
    [*]Updated the Alex AI.
    [*]Most Useless But Most Proud of: A new zoom feature for the Network Map. It properly zooms in on the center of the screen and remembers your position. Took weeks to do!

[/list] 

* The UK Translation affects only the spellings of words. It does not account for any colloquialisms or sayings that might seem out of place. I would appreciate any feedback on this in the forums.

notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.content:
What? New stuff? That's impossible, I don't believe it!

Well believe it, fictional person, because here's a list of changes!
 [list]
    [*]New "Glossary" of terms! Check it out by clicking the "?" button in the upper right.
    [*]Changed the hacking "trap" to block only the grid, allowing you to apply stop timers or even false alarms to skip it.
    [*]To compensate for this ease of difficulty, the False Destination Locator has had its price greatly increased.
    [*]Decreased the Job Deadlines a little bit; they were too long
    [*]Corrected a typo, but I'm not going to tell you where.
    [*]Added a faint icon to the background of external computers, what could it be?
[/list]
Also, there is a large improvement to how all lists are displayed. What's that? You didn't have any problems running the game as-is? Too bad, you're getting an optimization anyway! Mwahaha!

notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
Aw yeah! Lots of behind the scenes stuff but there's also a new program you can buy!

[list]
    [*]Defrag Program - Clean up that messy hard drive!
    [*]Steam checking - if there's a problem with Steam, Proxy will fail "gracefully!"
    [*]Safer saving and loading - Something happen to your files? Proxy won't flip out!
    [*]A new header for the "resolution" splash screen - neato!
[/list] 

There's also a "save migrator" in order to accommodate the new defrag program. THIS took the majority of the work, so I hope it's worth it!

o Bug fixes galore

o Surprise animation! Who can find it the fastest?
